text:
Maya: Quick sync — mapping critical path for Q3 roadmap. Key launch: Dedicated + Optimize autopilot for top 5 customers. Need cross-team dependency list.
Jonah: Can we list the must-have vs nice-to-have? I'm worried about runtime kernel work blocking the whole chain.
Sara: Must-have from infra: autoscaler v2, storage config, private networking certs. Nice-to-have: autoscaler UI polish.
Liam: SLOs: 95th p99 latency target depends on batching changes + KV cache. If batching delayed, we need traffic shaping.
Ana: Research: quantized 4-bit variants ready by 2026-05-15 but still need perf regression tests against long-context workloads.
Priya (CS): Enterprise customer Fortex requires on-prem package + KMS by EOW 2026-05-22 — this is high priority and a potential deal driver.
Carlos (PM - Dedicated): Timeline suggestion: freeze scope 2026-05-10, can we commit? :thinking:
Jonah: freeze 5/10 is tight. Need eng-runtime to finish kernel selection by 2026-05-05. Otherwise we'll ship with feature flags only.
Maya: Proposed critical path:
```
1) kernel selection (eng-runtime) complete by 2026-05-05
2) autoscaler v2 (eng-infra) feature complete by 2026-05-12
3) quantized model perf tests (eng-ml) by 2026-05-15
4) private deploy packaging & KMS (eng-platform) by 2026-05-20
5) console dashboards & rollouts (product/devex) by 2026-05-25
```
Jonah: Blocker: external lib update for attention op — assigning to @sara to triage (this could add ~3 days).
Sara: Confirmed, I've got a PR in flight. Risk: regression testing will need extra GPU hours.
Liam: We can schedule extra cluster time but that impacts Dedicated customer SLAs unless we buy burst credits.
Priya: For Fortex, if KMS isn't in time, they'll accept a hosted-only pilot — reduces near-term revenue but keeps momentum. Need contingency.
Ana: Contingency plan: offer pilot with strict private endpoints + audit logs instead of full KMS integration.
Carlos: Decision point: do we reduce scope (defer full KMS) or push timeline? Vote from teams? :raised_hands: 
Jonah: My vote: reduce scope, ship core inference and autoscaler; KMS in a patch release. Lower risk to date.
Maya: Product stance: prefer smaller launch and predictable date. We need clear launch criteria:
- Core inference: p99 <= 350ms for typical 1k-token workload
- Autoscaler stable under 2x baseline traffic for 30m without error spike >1%
- Rollout A/B + automatic fallback configured
- At least one customer pilot signoff (can be hosted if KMS deferred)
Priya: CS can sign off if audit logs + private endpoint available for the pilot.
Carlos: OK, new plan: scope cut to defer full KMS. Update milestones and communicate to Sales by 2026-05-06.
Maya: Action items:
- Jonah: finish kernel selection by 2026-05-05
- Sara: land PR + test infra by 2026-05-08
- Ana: run perf suite and share report by 2026-05-15
- Priya: update Fortex on pilot plan by 2026-05-04
- Liam: provision burst GPU credits by 2026-05-06
- Carlos: update roadmap doc and sales play by 2026-05-06
Jonah: I'll also add a short runbook for fallback routing and a smoke test checklist.
Sara: Adding a CI job to gate regressions and will annotate estimated extra GPU hours in the PR.
Maya: Thanks — can everyone confirm in thread with :thumbsup: and call out any remaining risks? We'll sync Wed 9am PT.
